name: list_metrics
description: List the governed metric definitions in a COA namespace (name, description, dimensions, synonyms). Call this first to discover which metrics exist before querying. Read-only. Returns {metrics, nextToken?}.

namespaceId.description: The COA namespace to list metrics for.

nextToken.description: Continuation token from a previous response.

name: describe_schema
description: Describe a COA namespace's ontology: classes, their properties, and the data-source tables behind them. Use it to learn what data exists and how entities relate before querying. Read-only. Returns {classes, ontologyVersion}.

classFilter.description: Restrict to one class IRI or IRI prefix.

name: get_namespace
description: Get a COA namespace's curated profile: display name, description and language, as authored by the namespace owner. Use it to frame the domain before querying. Read-only. Returns {namespace: {namespaceId, name, displayName, description, status, language}}.
